steps.title: Tie a small knot
steps.instruction: Type the changed lines, then press Run. Keep the rest of your working code.
steps.explain: A triangle uses three equal sides with a 120-degree turn between them. The first turn aims it downward.
steps.expected: A small triangle under the balloon.
steps.question: Why is the turn 120 rather than 90?
steps.answer: Three turns of 120 degrees make one full 360-degree turn.

steps.title: Start a curved string

steps.explain: The second input to circle is an angle. circle(50, 60) draws only 60 degrees of a circle.
steps.expected: A short curved string below the knot.
steps.question: What does the second number control?
steps.answer: How much of the circle is drawn.

steps.title: Let the string bend
steps.instruction: Type the changed lines, then press Run. Keep the rest of your working code.
steps.explain: A negative radius curves to the other side. Alternating the sign makes a gentle wave.
steps.question: Which numbers could you experiment with?
steps.answer: The radii change the bend size; the angles change how far each bend turns.
